card.name: Start of a value or qualifier
card.fires_on: Fires on the spot right before a number or qualifier is spelled out: an opening parenthesis before an abbreviation, a space before a dose or score value, or 'non' before a hyphenated term. Seen in drug-label dosing, scoring and toxicity text.

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: The gap or digit position just before a dose, threshold or score value.

modes.label: 'non' before a hyphen
modes.description: The prefix 'non' ahead of a hyphenated medical term such as non-infectious or non-hematological.

modes.label: Opening parenthesis before an abbreviation
modes.description: A bracket that introduces an abbreviation of a named study or criteria.
